messages.text: Nora sold her old monitor; I kept mine.

cases.rubric: Preserve the subject of keeping vs selling; the named third party is not the enclosing speaker.

messages.text: 我是小余。是我妹妹借走了投影仪，我没有借走。

drafts.content: 小余的妹妹没有借走投影仪。
drafts.subject: contact

cases.rubric: Negation belongs to the contact speaker, not the sibling; opaque sender identity does not change the sentence's referents.

messages.text: Omar told me, 'I cancelled my pass.' I renewed mine.

cases.rubric: Quoted first-person cancellation is Omar's; enclosing first-person renewal is the owner's.

messages.text: I booked the rehearsal room this morning.
You haven't booked a room. I could book one later.
